name: application-16
title: Marketing dashboard
description: A Tarnbrook marketing dashboard whose sidebar and cards settle in once, then one period switch moves every chart together: leads split by origin, goals as tick meters, daily traffic against the period before dashed, clicks by channel and month, a conversion funnel, the week's campaigns on a strip and a table of campaigns grouped by channel that sorts by column. Plug your analytics into onPeriodChange, onSortChange and onCampaignSelect.
